in_marathi.name: Sharutha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Love
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharutha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Goddess Sharutha is the embodiment of love and compassion. She is also known as the goddess of fertility and is often invoked for a successful pregnancy.
